honesty_banner: Premiums here are REAL NBBO quotes (OPRA via Databento), not model output. Quotes are 1-minute sampled consolidated BBO (cbbo-1m); the row stamped with an ET wall-clock minute is matched to the trade minute of the same stamp, with a +/-2 minute flagged fallback. A sampled quote is not a guaranteed fill: real fills can be worse. The Alpaca options paper forward test remains the arbiter.
